projectsData.title: Gacad — Academic Management System
projectsData.description: Web administrative core for academic management. Orchestrates enrollments, schedules, and distributions under distributed architecture patterns.
projectsData.longDescription: Comprehensive system where I architected and implemented the core for enrollments, schedule distributions, and attendance. Centralized digitization that eradicated dependence on physical formats and critically reduced audit times.

projectsData.title: My ISTPET — Student Mobile App
projectsData.description: Official app (schedules, grades, payments, digital ID). Implementation of Clean Architecture and CQRS serving ~400 concurrent users.
projectsData.longDescription: Comprehensive design and development of the mobile app in React Native. Its deployment eradicated the logistical failures of physical ID cards (printing errors, high costs), centralizing identity in a validated digital QR for teachers and students.

projectsData.title: DebtManager — C# Desktop App
projectsData.description: Native desktop application built in C# .NET for personal finance management, tracking debts, installments, and budgets with local storage.
projectsData.longDescription: Developed to provide agile, offline personal financial control. Features interactive loan amortization dashboards, due date alerts, report export, and secure storage in relational SQLite.

projectsData.title: Education Microservices Architecture
projectsData.description: CDMI Formatives (Scorecraft) and Microservices. Clean Architecture and CQRS applied to training school management.
projectsData.longDescription: Implementation of business infrastructure for sports training schools, participating in the relational database design alongside the development team and ensuring high scalability.

projectsData.title: Logic Engine: Java OOP Minesweeper
projectsData.description: Complete engine of the Minesweeper game developed under the Object-Oriented Programming paradigm in Java with complex two-dimensional matrix handling.
projectsData.longDescription: Implementation demonstrating mastery of fundamental computer science concepts: encapsulation, polymorphism, recursive handling of free cell uncovering, and mine matrix management.

projectsData.title: Inventory Optimization (Dynamic Prog.)
projectsData.description: Java system for enterprise inventory optimization comparing recursive, top-down (memoization), and bottom-up approaches.
projectsData.longDescription: Algorithmic application focused on solving the 0/1 Knapsack Problem applied to logistics and inventory, analyzing O(n*W) time complexity and identifying maximum processing efficiency.

projectsData.title: AMMI Online — Educational Platform
projectsData.description: Job Board and AMMI Online: Institutional platforms structured with CQRS for corporate automation.
projectsData.longDescription: Development of key ecosystems. In the Job Board, I achieved the total automation of agreement and business proposal generation, fluidly connecting graduates with the productive sector.

projectsData.title: AVIALB / SIAT — Ecuadorian National Police
projectsData.description: Traffic accident management (SIAT). Armored security with encryption of sensitive data and strict authentication (JWT).
projectsData.longDescription: Guaranteed the integrity of legal information and expert reports by implementing vehicular data encryption and a secure, police-grade authentication flow.

projectsData.title: Human Resources ERP (HR)
projectsData.description: HR ERP module with Clean Architecture and CQRS. Reduction from 2 days to 3 operational hours in payroll calculations.
projectsData.longDescription: Development of the web module architecture for comprehensive human talent management. Achieved a drastic reduction in the generation time of contracts, payroll, and vacation reports from 2 days to only 3 operational hours.

projectsData.title: Yui Project — Mental Health AI
projectsData.description: Conversational intelligent assistant focused on mental health support developed in Python with NLP and Machine Learning models.
projectsData.longDescription: Artificial Intelligence prototype exploring sentiment analysis, recurrent neural networks, and NLP techniques for empathetic user interaction.
